about: Zone 4 (bow): Talal 2026-11-28 answered 'yes' to 'the keel block under the bow is the base model's grey (Underside_Front); should the block's own colour be rust too?'. The block keeps its geometry and its material slot (M_Airship); only its palette class changes. The three islands are the whole Underside_Front source part (1147 the block, 1148 / 1149 one-triangle slivers of the same part). Applied by r3_base_recolor.py: the toon renders (after state), the assembler (face attribute + custom property in the full file) and the round 3 bake (palette slot).

recolors.why: keel block under the bow: grey -> rust like the bow wedge and the keel plates on it (Talal 2026-11-28, answer 1: yes)
